definition: 開源的容器編排系統，最早由 Google 開源，現在由 CNCF（雲端原生運算基金會）託管。核心做法是宣告想要的狀態：先寫下程式要跑幾份、各要多少資源、怎麼對外開放，控制器就會一直把實際狀態拉回這個樣子，例如補回掛掉的容器、把工作排到還有空間的機器上。常簡寫成 K8s，因為 K 和 s 中間剛好八個字母。
moguNote: Kubernetes 就是一家餐廳：店長把想要的樣子寫在白板上，每一行白板配一位專門盯它的經理。廚房斷電、廚師倒了，經理一概不問為什麼，只管把現場改回白板寫的樣子。至於叫 K8s，就是中間那八個字母太長，懶得打 (￣▽￣)
enDefinition: An open-source container orchestration system, originally open-sourced by Google and now hosted by the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation). Its core idea is declaring a desired state: how many copies to run, how much resource each one needs, and how they are exposed. Controllers then keep pulling the actual state back to match, for example by replacing crashed containers or scheduling work onto machines with room to spare. Often shortened to K8s, since there are exactly eight letters between the K and the s.
enMoguNote: Kubernetes is basically a restaurant. The boss writes the desired state on a whiteboard, and every line on it gets its own manager. A kitchen loses power, cooks vanish, and the manager never asks why; it just drags reality back to whatever the whiteboard says. As for K8s: typing those eight middle letters was apparently too much work (￣▽￣)
